name: Stick to ceiling
description: Snaps Mario to the underside of the ceiling block ($96/$97 from $98/$99, adjusting for $73 ducking, $19 powerup, $187A Yoshi and $13DC) and keeps his vertical speed ($7D) negative so he clings to the ceiling while holding the selected button ($15, $17). Releasing the button sets $7D to 0 to drop.
author: BlockCreator
